hni_signals: VERY STRONG - the highest-signal profile in this batch. (1) NAMED MEDICAL DEVICE AND COMMERCIALISATION: co-developer of the biodegradable 'Asthana Stent', a dissolving biliary stent for liver-transplant patients developed with IISc; per trade press the device 'is now moving from laboratory development to commercial production after being licensed to Advanced Medtech Solutions Private Limited under an Indian patent' - i.e. named-inventor IP with a licensing revenue path. It is in a registered clinical trial (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06716541, 'Biodegradable Stents in Liver Transplant RecipIents for Treatment of Biliary Anastomotic Strictures'). (2) LEADERSHIP: Clinical Lead of Hepatobiliary Surgery and Multiorgan Transplantation for the Integrated Liver Care Team across the ASTER GROUP of hospitals - a group-level, multi-city clinical leadership post, not a single-unit consultancy. (3) MULTI-SITE, MULTI-CITY PRACTICE: Aster CMI Hebbal, Aster RV and Aster Whitefield (Bengaluru), Aster Medcity (Kochi), plus a CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills (Hyderabad) listing. (4) ACADEMIC POST: Adjunct Faculty, Biomaterials Engineering, IISc Department of Materials Engineering - collaborating with Prof. Kaushik Chatterjee's group on tumour/liver organoids and 3D bio-stereolithography for engineering functional tissues. (5) INTERNATIONAL TRAINING AND CREDENTIALS: MBBS and MS from JIPMER Pondicherry; subspecialty training in Surgical Oncology at AIIMS New Delhi; MRCS, Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh; MSc, University of Alberta, Canada; four years in the Liver Unit at St James's University Hospital, Leeds, UK from 2003; Fellowship in Multi-organ Transplantation, Edmonton, Canada, ASTS-accredited; selected for the European Health Leadership Program at INSEAD, France. (6) RESEARCH OUTPUT: more than 40 publications and scientific articles in international journals, plus numerous abstracts and presentations at national and international meetings; first-in-India 3D printing model for planning donor hepatectomy in living donor liver transplantation (published in PMC). (7) EDITORIAL AND SOCIETY RECOGNITION: Liver Transplant Editor at WebmedCentral; award recipient from the British Transplant Society, the American Society of Transplantation and the Canadian Transplant Society; Alberta Heritage (AHFMR) fellowship; AASLD HPB Surgery and Liver Transplantation award. (8) PREMIUM SPECIALTY: liver/multi-organ transplantation is among the highest-value surgical specialties in India. owns_clinic set false - transplantationliver.com is the Aster Integrated Liver Care programme site, not evidence of an independently owned clinic.

notes:
HIGH band justified by THREE genuinely independent official sources that agree on name + specialty + qualifications: (1) carehospitals.com own per-doctor page, titled 'Dr. Sonal Asthana | Best Liver Transplant and Hepatobiliary Surgeon in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad | CARE Hospitals'; (2) asterhospitals.in - a different, unrelated hospital group - with two official doctor pages (Aster CMI/RV/Whitefield Bangalore, and Aster Medcity Kochi); (3) materials.iisc.ac.in, an .ac.in ACADEMIC domain, listing 'Dr. Sonal Asthana, MBBS, MS (General Surgery)' as Adjunct Faculty in Biomaterials Engineering. Distinctive name, no ambiguity risk.

AFFILIATION FLAG (this is the key thing for a human to note): the CARE Hyderabad link looks like a SECONDARY or VISITING arrangement, not his base. His primary, current and by far best-evidenced post is Aster - 'Clinical Lead of the Hepatobiliary Surgery and Multiorgan Transplantation, Integrated Liver Care Team, Aster Group of Hospitals', based at Aster CMI Hospital, Hebbal, Bengaluru. Aster describes him as presently working there; the Bengaluru association the brief anticipated is confirmed. The CARE Banjara Hills page is real (it is CARE's own indexed per-doctor page and cannot be dismissed), and CARE also lists him on its liver-transplant speciality page, but no news, appointment announcement or CARE department page corroborates a full-time Hyderabad base, and a targeted 'joins CARE 2025/2026' search returned no such announcement. Treat him as Bengaluru-primary with a CARE Hyderabad listing; approach via the Bengaluru/Aster or personal-email routes, not the Hyderabad switchboard.

CONTACT VERIFICATION, done exactly as the brief requires. THREE candidate contacts were exact-phrase re-checked: (a) 'sonal@transplantationliver.com' - CONFIRMED and recorded: the quoted search returned his IISc Materials Engineering faculty page (materials.iisc.ac.in, official academic domain) as the top result plus his own transplantationliver.com doctor page, so it is genuinely published on pages belonging to him. (b) '8884263701' - CONFIRMED as a DEPARTMENT line and recorded as such: the quoted search returned the Aster CMI Multi-Organ Transplant Centre-of-Excellence page and the Aster CMI Integrated Liver Care liver-transplantation page, i.e. the department he clinically leads. It is a departmental number, NOT his personal mobile, and is labelled that way. (c) 'ilc.arv@asterhospital.com' (offered by a summary for Aster RV) - DISCARDED: the quoted search returned no Aster page at all, only unrelated 'ILC' results and a SignalHire broker page, so it failed the check. Likewise '+91-40-68106529', repeatedly pushed by summaries for CARE doctors, is CARE's group central switchboard and was rejected per brief. A RocketReach 'email & phone' page for him surfaced and was ignored as a barred contact-broker source.

One search summary referred to him as 'she'; every hospital and press source says 'he'. That is a summariser artefact, and gender is not asserted in any recorded field. LinkedIn URL was taken verbatim from a search result ('Sonal Asthana - Indian Institute of Science (IISc) | LinkedIn'), and its stated IISc affiliation matches the independently confirmed IISc adjunct faculty post, which is what ties the profile to this person. No ORCID or Google Scholar profile surfaced despite his research output.
